requirement: the plugin must not crash the DSH desktop host, and a device token issued by one relay must trigger a re-pair when the configured relay no longer accepts it

host_crash.symptom: dsh: fatal load failure: TypeError: agent.identity is not a function
host_crash.cause: agent.identity?.() — the desktop host exposes identity as a property, so the optional CALL threw inside agent.start().then(...) and became an unhandled rejection
host_crash.fix: agentIdentityOf() type-checks before calling; agent.start runs with its failure recorded, never awaited as a mount prerequisite

relay_switch.symptom: the Rabbit refused GET /v1/devices with HTTP 401 (UNAUTHORIZED: missing or invalid device_token), 无列表
relay_switch.cause: startup saw a stored token and skipped pairing; the token belonged to the OLD relay after the fleet moved to a new primary
relay_switch.fix: probe the configured relay with the stored token; an explicit 401/403 drops it and re-pairs via the fleet key, while network errors keep it
